public_source_heads.source_scope: AlreadyLocked versus permanent LockException semantics and Windows/POSIX lock behavior used to refine event-log authority

exact_continuation: Start with the event-lock wrapper decision under the Portalocker exception contract: map an AlreadyLocked-only indefinite writer retry and a permanent-LockException regression, then write literal Supervisor FOUND/ABSENT/UNKNOWN planner-verdict replay tests against the existing outbox fixture. Next map a spawned-process event-lock integration test into PORTABLE_TESTS, then move iter_call_events and Mission View to the stable-generation primitive. Continue candidate008 durability and candidate005 transition_id provenance separately.

run_findings.candidate_010_supervisor_contract: FOUND skips planner-verdict re-emit then acknowledges; ABSENT alone authorizes one re-emit after complete stable scan; UNKNOWN keeps outbox pending and returns PLAN_RETRY without Planner invocation
run_findings.candidate_010_byte_scan: scan stable snapshots as bytes; target-relevant decode/JSON ambiguity is UNKNOWN unless a valid matching verdict is found; unrelated malformed rows whose raw bytes cannot contain the canonical SHA256 delivery id need not poison absence proof
run_findings.candidate_009_lock_exception_hazard: current core exclusive_file_lock retries every portalocker LockException; naively adding timeout=None would loop forever on permanent lock failures. Portalocker v3.0.0 already distinguishes AlreadyLocked contention from permanent LockException
run_findings.candidate_009_lock_recommendation: lowest-blast-radius path is an event-specific writer wrapper that waits indefinitely only on AlreadyLocked and propagates permanent errors; broader core-helper cleanup needs compatibility tests while preserving the 30s default for current callers
run_findings.candidate_009_reader_writer_policy: canonical writer may wait indefinitely on contention; correctness readers can be bounded where timeout maps to UNKNOWN/query failure. POSIX readers can pin handles plus end offsets under shared flock; Windows correctness-first readers may hold an exclusive lock while scanning
run_findings.candidate_009_portable_test: mirror tests/core/test_daemon_lock.py multiprocessing.get_context spawned-process pattern; it is already in PORTABLE_TESTS and therefore is a source-exact Windows CI precedent
run_findings.candidate_010_iter_call_events: stable-snapshot acquisition/read failure can naturally use event_log_query's existing exit-2 query-error path; completed no-match remains exit 1
run_findings.candidate_007_status: Mission View reconciliation should consume the same stable-generation primitive and preserve events.lock -> mission-view.lock ordering plus legacy-baseline migration
run_findings.candidate_008_status: unchanged separate power-loss durability hypothesis; no incident reproduced
run_findings.candidate_005_transition_lineage_patch: optional existing Manager intent ID -> stage_history transition_id remains provenance-only and separate
